title: Assam Buranji: Comprehensive History of Assam from Ancient Times Through the Ahom Dynasty
title_english: Assam Buranji: Comprehensive History of Assam from Ancient Times Through the Ahom Dynasty
title_as: আসাম বুৰঞ্জী: প্ৰাচীন কালৰ পৰা আহোম যুগলৈ বিস্তৃত ইতিহাস
author: Gunabhiram Barua
description: Gunabhiram Barua's monumental nineteenth-century chronicle synthesizing indigenous Ahom sanchi-bark puthis with modern critical historiography, documenting the Patkai migrations, the Nora ancestral relationship, the royal councils (Patra-Mantri), and social institutions.
